coordinates.locator: geometry:chooz-vns-position (intersection of the NUCLEUS baselines 72 m to B-1 and 102 m to B-2)
coordinates.note: Derived from the NUCLEUS baselines about the B1/B2 unit centroids; the solution lies inside the office building between the units that the paper describes.

name: Chooz very-near site (NUCLEUS)
notes: This site is distinct from any Double Chooz near or far detector site: NUCLEUS is described in its own papers as sited 'very near' the reactor cores, much closer than Double Chooz's near detector. Its position is derived from the NUCLEUS baselines of 72 m to reactor unit B-1 and 102 m to B-2 (see the coordinate note), not from a surveyed point.

summary.plain: A location very close to the reactor core at the Chooz nuclear power plant in France, where the NUCLEUS experiment is being built to catch antineutrinos with extremely sensitive cryogenic detectors.
summary.technical: NUCLEUS's 'very-near' site at the EDF Chooz B nuclear power plant, Ardennes, France; its position is derived from the NUCLEUS baselines of 72 m to reactor unit B-1 and 102 m to B-2.
